title.zh: Vitalik 提出 EIP-8288 最大化方案，主张以 STARK 支持任意签名方案并可能停止新增预编译
title.en: Vitalik: EIP-8288 Enables Arbitrary Signature Schemes, Ethereum May Never Need N

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin 提出了“EIP-8288 最大化”方案，将把以太坊的密码学策略转向该标准，并可能停止新增预编译合约；此举正值他与 a16z 和 StarkWare 就最佳密码学路线展开争论之际。
current_state.en: Vitalik Buterin has proposed an 'EIP-8288 maximization' approach that would shift Ethereum's cryptography strategy toward the standard and potentially stop adding new precompiles, amid debate with a16z and StarkWare over the best cryptographic roadmap.

updates.title_zh: Vitalik：EIP-8288 支持任意签名方案，以太坊可能永远无需 N
updates.title_en: Vitalik: EIP-8288 Enables Arbitrary Signature Schemes, Ethereum May Never Need N
updates.what_changed_zh: Vitalik Buterin 表示，EIP-8288 将允许用户通过 STARK 和聚合器证明任意签名方案，从而可能使以太坊永远无需新增签名预编译合约。
updates.what_changed_en: Vitalik Buterin said EIP-8288 would let users prove arbitrary signature schemes with STARKs and an aggregator, potentially sparing Ethereum from ever adding new signature precompiles.
